title: Initial abdominal-depth replicate disagreement does not establish added fasting-insulin prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: In 1996 development and 1897 target NHANES adults, adding initial abdominal-depth replicate disagreement changed weighted log-insulin MSE reduction by -0.00028578 (500 joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00294341, 0.00057882]); added predictive benefit was not established. Source grouped cross-validation also worsened. No independent clinical-program confirmation or causal claim. Autonomous AI authorship; clean offline rerun and author numerical checks, not independent peer review.
